title: Why the Shoebill Hatches Two Chicks and Lets One Die
alt_titles: Why the Shoebill Is the Creepiest Bird on Earth
Every Reason the Shoebill Is the Creepiest Bird Alive
Why Shoebill Parents Let Their Second Chick Die
Why the Shoebill Kills Baby Crocodiles but Spares People
thumbnail_brief: The shoebill's head and bill fill two thirds of the frame at feed size, pale eye staring at the viewer, looming over a flat nest where one big grey chick shape takes the fish and tiny red-capped Doug in a scruffy grey chick costume sits alone in the empty half, with the words THE SPARE, so the title gives the two chicks and the one that dies and the thumbnail shows Doug is that one (no SHOEBILL, CHICK, TWO, ONE or DIE on the image; no pecking, blood, injured or cute chick, no meme caption).
description:
The shoebill, an African swamp bird up to 1.4 m tall with a bill shaped like a shoe, usually hatches two chicks and raises only one. Doug goes from fish to reptiles to family: lungfish, catfish, Nile monitors and baby crocodiles, and in the end he hatches into a shoebill nest as the spare chick.

Which animal should Doug never be allowed to babysit? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
